digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and sidecar payload assembly
propositions: Signed gate verdicts must record provider, resolved model, endpoint host, tier, and effective capabilities in an additive provider_provenance object alongside the existing model string field, enabling consumers to distinguish Bedrock-backed verdicts from Anthropic-backed or Ollama-backed verdicts

The provider_provenance assembly in capabilities.py must take only primitives (provider: str, base_url: str | None, caps: ModelCapabilities) to preserve the leaf-module invariant and must never recompute the capability record, instead reusing the single record resolved at runner.py:357
The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname via urlparse(base_url).hostname, never .netloc, to prevent credential material from reaching the persisted payload

The additive-only design must not break backward compatibility: legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance must load and verify; tier assignment distinguishes first_class (direct provider) from best_effort (REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL custom base)

The provider_provenance record must be threaded from runner.run() through findings.finalize_outcome into the plan-review, completion, and code-review gate verdicts via finalize_verdict, ensuring the real assembly path (not just unit test hand-built verdicts) carries provenance to sidecar.build_payload

A credential oracle test must assert that base_url with embedded credentials (https://user:secret@host/v1) produces persisted endpoint_host=host with neither username, password, nor api_key appearing anywhere in the persisted sidecar payload
